operation.condition: The index covers the same immutable decoded trace and base grid as the windows.
operation.calculation: For each window, find the first change strictly after its start. A departure occurred on the base grid if that change is at or before the endpoint. Accumulate count bounds.
operation.costBoundary: Compare the full verified index payload to the relevant packed-source footprint and account for invocation reuse.

authority: Decoded label changes in two archived traces. Counters measure application reads from prepared files. Each trace charges its additional index proof once per invocation.
